detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same young man throughout seen from above, same short black hair, same pale-blue shirt. The camera holds a static shot. Seen from directly above and behind, his right hand draws the suitcase a few centimetres closer to his leg, then his shoulders draw inward once; his feet stay pressed together on the empty polished floor. an air-conditioning hum only. [Shot 2] At 00:03.375, the camera cuts to the framing holds a medium two-shot of the sofa. The camera stands on the inner side of the double-height living room near the staircase at eye level, about 1.5 metres up, looking down the room toward the full-height glass wall and the pool beyond. The camera holds a static shot. The older woman blows once across her own fingernails held up in front of her eyes and then rotates her wrist to look at them from another angle; the younger one's thumb swipes twice across her phone screen; both keep their eyelids lowered on their own hands throughout. a soft blow of breath, two light touch-screen taps.
